## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit has a sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] `check` and `budget` are green on my machine, or I am waiting for CI.
- [ ] For every new external dependency, I say here why it is needed and how much time it adds to a clean build.
- [ ] For a change that users will see, there is a change file from `knope document-change`.
- [ ] Changed documentation is changed in English and in Simplified Chinese.
